review_notes: Preflight NEEDS_REVIEW (interface-vs-method judgement, no auto-signals). Resolved by cold read: the instruction and submission_format.md state the interface only (two files, header, allowed labels, five keys); layout_spec.md states the domain rules (page size, running order, length, floor, verdict priority, figure meanings) and never a method or tool. Guess points listed and each settled in the text: line numbering from 1 ('the first passage beginning on the first line'); which page a passage is on ('the page its first line falls on'); several edits on one passage ('every accepted edit proposed for it'); a cut to exactly zero ('never falls below 1 line'); whether the held line moves later passages ('The lines the floor holds back are real lines'); verdict precedence ('whatever else is true of it'); final page ('the page the manuscript's last line falls on'); row order ('in any order'); id form ('PS-04, not PS4 or 4'). The one requester lead ('the edits from the second read are the ones at the bottom') is literally true and says nothing about how edits combine.

review_notes: Preflight NEEDS_REVIEW x3. (a) domain_correctness, 'are the domain figures fictional or exactly cited?': fictional and self-contained. The manuscript, passages, line counts and edits are invented; the 30-lines-a-page layout is the fixture's own spec, stated in layout_spec.md, not a claim about any real press or style guide; the instruction cites nothing. No figure needs an external source. (b) workflow_realism, 'would a professional recognise this ask?': yes. After a copyedit or second read, an author or production editor re-derives page references for flagged or queried passages (index entries, cross-references, permissions and proof queries), accepted and deferred changes are tracked-change states, and a passage whose text is cut away keeps its place-holding line (scene break or heading) so later pages do not jump. Two independent edits proposed against the same draft passage that together exceed it are routine when two readers mark the same draft. (c) Leakage, as mined: the instruction named the deciding case and its remedy ('One of the cuts is as long as the passage it is cutting, so do not let that passage vanish and pull everything else back with it'), and the ledger's edit_code column did the passage-edit join for the agent.
